decision_cruda.rationale: LH-01 is down at N600-09 (radio and CMMS agree; likely repair 13:20). Norte is already truck-limited (inflow 71 vs trucks 66 t/h, and the stockpile plus inflow exceeds what trucks can haul by 17:00), so a loan there adds nothing. Este has spare truck capacity (72 vs 33 t/h), and E543-11 has 289 t at 8.3 g/t with only LH-05, which would leave about 52 t unloaded by 17:00. LH-08 comes from the cheap infrastructure heading (0.2 oz/h), travels 0.55 h, and mucks that remainder: about 14 oz gained against about 1.5 oz of development lost. The development heading DS-E543-02 (4 oz/h) is left alone. No stope is stopped, so no reserve activations.

Norte has only LH-03 working but trucks (66 t/h) plus 241 t stockpile are nearly saturated, so one cheap loader helps: LH-08 (infrastructure heading, 0.2 oz/h) to N600-09 (11.9 g/t), arrives ~10:39, ~+14 oz net. LH-09 is critical path (4 oz/h) so it stays. LH-10 is free from 11:00 and goes to Este (E543-11, 269 t at 8.3 g/t, trucks have spare 39 t/h), roughly +19 oz. Central is already truck-limited. Norte N522-15 is not covered because it would exceed truck capacity. The radio and CMMS agree on both failures, so no confirmation is needed.
